name: Lotus Lake Camp
description_short: Full-day camp, 9:00-4:00 Monday to Friday, for children entering grades K-9. Campers are grouped by grade and do Red Cross swim lessons, boats or archery, crafts or tennis, and woodshop or outdoor adventure, plus a daily lunch hike into the woods.
swim_waterfront_notes: Red Cross swim lessons. Campers must pass LLC's own deep water test, without goggles, to swim in the deep end outside of lessons. Boating is offered as an activity choice.

There is also a CIT program for campers going into 10th grade ($1650). No dates are given; families are asked to email if interested.
